{{Quote|Did you serve with the RASP long, sir?"''<br />''"The whole ten years, time of my life.|[[Ben Skywalker]] to [[Lon Shevu]] who was posing as a retired RASP pilot|<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Invincible">''[[Legacy of the Force: Invincible]]''</ref>}}
The '''Reconstruction Authority Space Patrol''' ('''RASP'''), also known as the '''Reconstruction Police''', was the [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement branch]] of the [[Reconstruction Authority]] which was set up by the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] in the aftermath of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. They were assigned the duty of fighting [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] and [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]].

The RASP were known for using [[XJ5 X-wing starfighter]]s. During their years of operation, they claimed to have captured the pirate [[Three-Eye]], but in actuality, Three-Eye had already been captured by two [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] who handed the pirate over to them.

Around [[39 ABY]], the RASP was disbanded.
